maddeler.e:
انتجعوا (form VIII)
# اِنْتَجَعُوا (intajaʕū) /in.ta.d͡ʒa.ʕuː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِنْتَجَعَ (intajaʕa)
# اُنْتُجِعُوا (untujiʕū) /un.tu.d͡ʒi.ʕuː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of اِنْتَجَعَ (intajaʕa)
# اِنْتَجِعُوا (intajiʕū) /in.ta.d͡ʒi.ʕuː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِنْتَجَعَ (intajaʕa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
